title: A content landing runs the lookup eval when it changes kb facts
goal: backlog.py land runs the land_eval step (rag.py eval) for a landing that changes kb articles or data, not only for one that changes _tools/, so a fact that turns an off-kb eval row into a good answer stops the landing instead of reaching main

run:
import inspect, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import bl_land
s = inspect.getsource(bl_land)
i = s.find('else:  # lint.py takes')
sys.exit(0 if i > 0 and 'land_eval()' in s[i:i + 1500] else 1)

gates.question: Which changed files make a content landing run the lookup eval?

notes: Retrospective of SP-z6wolmvm (2026-10-22, operator accepted): ST-qgojhpot added the Purview endpoint DLP onboarding facts (0cc2bf9ff9) and landed; rag.py eval then failed on main on EV-purview-endpoint-dlp-onboarding-requirements-windows (want none, got good) until ST-xfuucxk2 changed the row. bl_land.py runs land_heavy() (land_eval and lint) only when the landing changes _tools/ (the `if any(p.startswith("_tools/")` branch), so content landings skip the eval. The draft check reads the source; planning replaces it with a planted content landing.
